properties.description: A similarity score does not decide identity: sibling names stay apart and true duplicates still converge (crates/reflow2-core/tests/sibling_merge.rs, 5 cases). Nine crates sharing the `dynograph-` prefix survive as nine nodes each carrying its OWN name — before BL-213 this was five, with two carrying a sibling's name. An abbreviation (Auth / Authentication) is never reported as distinguished; a version suffix (Auth Service v2) is; reordered tokens (Read Path Cache / Cache Read Path) still converge, so BL-186's ordering fix is untouched; and a held-back merge names the word that held it.
properties.findings: MUTATION-CHECKED: disabling the discriminator restores the 5-of-9 loss and fails exactly the three tests naming those properties, while the two that should be insensitive to it still pass. FIELD-CHECKED against the real dev_storyflow document that found the defect: 9 of 9 crates survive.
properties.name: A similarity score does not decide identity
